name: Spiderwort

facts.how: Leaves and stems raw or cooked; flowers as garnish

caution: A safe, well-known edible; the blue flowers and grass-like leaves are distinctive. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Grassy arching leaves and three-petaled blue-violet flowers that each last a single morning. Break a leaf and it draws a fine mucilage thread.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Young leaves and stems eat like a slightly slick green vegetable, raw or cooked; the flowers pretty up a plate.
